name: FluidRWA
description: FluidRWA is a vendor discovery, research and matchmaking platform for Web3, real-world asset tokenization and AI.
coverageScope: Coverage includes Web3 and AI directory listings and vendors tracked across blockchain-project ecosystems. A company may appear in multiple categories; tracked does not mean vetted.

reviewAreas.name: Product and operating track record
reviewAreas.description: Review the actual service, documentation and evidence of delivery. For blockchain products, ask for relevant production deployments and transaction evidence; for AI and other services, use appropriate operating examples.

reviewAreas.name: Client work and references
reviewAreas.description: Examine relevant case studies and supporting references where available. Distinguish a named client engagement from an integration, ecosystem membership or partner logo.

reviewAreas.name: Regulatory claims and service scope
reviewAreas.description: Check claimed registrations or permissions against the named entity, activity and jurisdiction where applicable. A software vendor does not need the same permissions as a custodian or payment operator.

reviewAreas.name: Leadership and company identity
reviewAreas.description: Review the people behind the business, its corporate identity and the entity responsible for the proposed service. Separate a group brand from the company entering the contract.

reviewAreas.name: Website, documentation and ecosystem presence
reviewAreas.description: Check whether the public product description, documentation, company channels and supporting materials are consistent and relevant to the service being reviewed.

reviewAreas.name: Feedback and reputation
reviewAreas.description: Consider client feedback, references and material reputation concerns in context. Testimonials and a lack of public complaints are not guarantees of service quality or future performance.

reviewScope: FluidRWA's vendor review is not a code-level security audit, legal opinion, financial due diligence, regulatory approval or guarantee of performance. Buyers remain responsible for their own project-specific assessment.
feeScope: There is a fee for the vetting review. Marketing, visibility and advertising are separate services with separate fees. Payment does not determine the review outcome or guarantee a Vetted badge.
